amphenol.name: Circular MIL-Spec Connectors
amphenol.description: Amphenol circular MIL-spec connectors (MIL-DTL-38999, MIL-DTL-26482, SheerPwr) for defence, aerospace, marine and harsh environment applications. Highlights: MIL-DTL-38999 Series I, II, III and MIL-DTL-26482 series; Harsh environment rated with EMI/RFI shielding; Multiple shell sizes, plating options, and contact arrangements.

amphenol.name: Industrial Circular Connectors (M12 / M8 / SPE)
amphenol.description: Amphenol industrial circular connectors - robust, reliable connectivity for factory automation, robotics, sensor networks, and Single Pair Ethernet. Highlights: IP67/IP68 submersible rated options; M12, M8, M23 and Single Pair Ethernet configurations; Screw, bayonet, and push-pull rapid locking mechanisms.

amphenol.name: D-Subminiature Connectors
amphenol.description: Amphenol D-subminiature connectors for data, signal and mixed-layout power applications. Available in standard, high-density, combo-D and filtered variants. Highlights: Standard (9 to 50 pin) and high-density (15 to 78 pin) layouts; Solder cup, crimp, and PCB mount terminations; Integrated EMI/RFI filtered and IP67 waterproof options.

amphenol.name: High-Speed Backplane & Mezzanine PCB Connectors
amphenol.description: Amphenol industry-leading high-speed backplane (Paladin, ExaMAX, XCede) and board-to-board mezzanine connectors delivering speeds up to 112Gb/s PAM4. Highlights: High-speed differential pairs supporting 56Gb/s to 112Gb/s PAM4; Paladin, ExaMAX, and XCede backplane architectures; Zero-skew architecture and lowest crosstalk in class.
amphenol.images: Amphenol, Electronics Components, Consumer Electronics, Telecommunications, Industrial Automation

amphenol.name: Heavy Duty RADSOK Power Connectors
amphenol.description: Amphenol proprietary RADSOK contact technology delivering up to 50% higher ampacity in smaller footprints with lowest contact resistance for heavy industrial power. Highlights: Patented hyperbolic grid contact geometry; High current capacity from 35A up to 1000A continuous; Low insertion force and ultra-low millivolt drop.

amphenol.name: Rugged Harsh-Environment USB & RJ45 Modular Jacks
amphenol.description: Amphenol sealed USB, HDMI, and RJ45 modular jacks engineered with IP67/IP68 die-cast housings for field communication and extreme environment terminals. Highlights: IP67 / IP68 die-cast zinc and polymer sealed shells; Rugged USB Type-A, Type-C, and Cat6A RJ45 configurations; Positive locking latching and bayonet coupling.
amphenol.images: Amphenol, Electronics Components, Defense, Telecommunications, Industrial Automation

amphenol.name: High Precision GNSS Antennas
amphenol.description: Amphenol active multi-band GNSS antennas supporting GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, and BeiDou for sub-meter navigation, asset tracking, and timing. Highlights: Multi-band GNSS (L1/L2/L5/E1/E5b) support; High-gain integrated low noise amplifier (LNA); IP67 waterproof and UV-resistant radomes.
amphenol.images: Amphenol, Electronics Components, Telecommunications, Railways, Automotive, Defense

amphenol.name: 5G & 4G LTE Cellular Wideband Antennas
amphenol.description: Amphenol 4G LTE and 5G wideband cellular antennas for IoT gateways, smart meters, industrial routers, telematics kiosks, and base stations. amphenol.name: Wi-Fi 6E & Bluetooth Dual-Band Antennas
amphenol.description: Amphenol high-performance Wi-Fi 6E (2.4GHz, 5GHz, 6GHz) and Bluetooth articulated rubber-duck dipole and terminal antennas for wireless routers and APs. amphenol.name: Internal Embedded Flexible FPC Antennas
amphenol.description: Ultra-thin flexible peel-and-stick FPC antennas with IPEX micro coaxial leads for compact IoT devices, wearable medical equipment, and smart meters. amphenol.name: Vehicle Telematics Multi-in-One Combo Antennas

amphenol.images: Amphenol, Electronics Components, Automotive, Railways, Defense, Telecommunications

amphenol.name: Precision RF Coaxial Connectors (SMA / BNC / N / TNC)
amphenol.description: Amphenol RF coaxial connectors - SMA, SMB, BNC, N-Type, TNC, and 7/16 DIN precision engineered for high-frequency signal integrity and test racks. amphenol.name: Tested Precision RF Coaxial Cable Assemblies
amphenol.description: Amphenol precision RF cable assemblies featuring low-loss micro-coax cables, 100% factory verified VSWR and phase-matching for telecom and test labs. amphenol.name: Micro-Miniature RF Connectors (MCX / MMCX / AMC)
amphenol.description: Amphenol ultra-miniature coaxial connectors (MCX, MMCX, AMC/IPEX) designed for high-density space-constrained mobile, GPS, and IoT circuitry. amphenol.name: Fiber Optic Connectors & Optical Patch Cords
